text: Guided systematic review workflow covering search, screening, data extraction, and a final summary report
quote: The Systematic Reviews workflow provides step-by-step guidance through search, screening, and data extraction, culminating in a research report summarizing the relevant papers.

text: Run a full systematic review end to end with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting
quote: Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.

text: Users set an effort level for each Research Agent session, from Fastest to Smartest, before sending a question
quote: click it to open the slider and move between Fastest, Fast, Balanced, Smart, and Smartest

text: Instant email alerts notify you whenever a new relevant research paper is found
quote: Turn on **Instant email alerts** to be immediately alerted whenever a new relevant research paper is found.

text: Alerts track the latest research on chosen topics so new papers can be added to your Library
quote: Alerts allow you to stay up to date on the latest research about topics that are relevant to you, so you can add them to your Library for future use.

text: Import paper collections from Zotero for data extraction and analysis
quote: Elicit's Zotero integration helps you bring your paper collections into Elicit, where you can extract data and analyze your papers!

text: Export the Library as a RIS file for Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, or other reference managers
quote: Your Elicit Library can be exported as a .ris file, which you can import into Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, or another reference manager.

text: Import RIS and BIB files from tools like EndNote, Mendeley, or Rayyan for automated screening and extraction
quote: You can import RIS and BIB files into Elicit. This makes it much easier to import titles/abstracts from other tools like EndNote, Mendeley, or Rayyan to use with Elicit's automated screening and extraction.

text: Projects link multiple sessions so they can see each other's artifacts and keep context
quote: Sessions within a project can see each other's artifacts and other content to help you switch between different session types without losing context.

text: Reusable skills give the agent a set of instructions for approaching a task a particular way
quote: Instead of writing out the same detailed prompt every time you run a market sizing or a landscape review, you reference the skill and the agent follows it.

text: Skills can be found and invoked by typing / in the prompt box
quote: Type / in the prompt box to open a searchable list of skills.

text: Invite teammates to collaborate live in Research Agent sessions, asking questions and editing artifacts
quote: Invite your team members to collaborate live with you in Research Agent sessions. Collaborators with edit access can ask the agent questions in your session, produce new artifacts (documents, tables, etc.), and edit other artifacts

text: Share a view-only link with people who don't have an Elicit account
quote: Toggle on "Anyone with the link can view", then click "Copy link". This works for people without an Elicit account

text: Browser extension uses your institutional logins to download full-text papers you have access to
quote: The extension uses your active logins in your browser to download papers your institution gives you access to.

text: Elicit automatically fetches full-text papers during systematic review data extraction
quote: Elicit will automatically fetch papers during the data extraction phase of your Systematic Reviews

text: Browser extension adds on average 30 percentage points more full-text papers to extraction
quote: this extension still adds, on average, 30 percentage points more full-text papers to the extraction step of your Systematic Reviews

text: Add extraction columns by telling the Research Agent in natural language what to add
quote: To add a column, simply tell the research agent what column(s) you'd like to add. For example, you can say: "Add a column for study type."

text: Extraction columns pull data from paper body text and from tables, and quote tables they use
quote: Elicit's columns will consider any tables within a paper when generating the answers for your columns. If Elicit uses information from a table, it will quote the table

text: Research Agent draws on publications, public filings, and press releases, and lets you iterate on outputs
quote: the Research Agent can pull from a wide range of sources (e.g. publications, public filings, press releases), produce flexible outputs, and let you iterate until you have exactly what you need

text: Within the conversation you can filter and export sources, save papers, generate figures, and draft slides
quote: filter and export your sources, save papers to your Library, generate figures, and draft slides, all without leaving the conversation

text: Export systematic review screening and data extraction tables on Pro, Scale, and Enterprise plans
quote: Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.

text: Export tables as CSV and Excel, and certain source tables as RIS or BIB
quote: Tables can be exported in CSV and Excel format. Certain tables of sources can be exported as RIS or BIB files.

text: Export research reports as PDF or Word on every plan
quote: Research Reports can be exported as a PDF or Word file, regardless of which Elicit plan you subscribe to.

text: Semantic search finds relevant papers from natural-language questions without exact keywords
quote: With Elicit's semantic search engine, you can ask a question in natural language, and Elicit will find relevant papers, without you having to think of every possible keyword to search for.

text: Search across more than 138 million academic papers
quote: Unlimited search across more than 138 million papers

text: Search clinical trials as well as research papers
quote: Elicit allows you to search both research papers and clinical trials.

text: Keyword and Boolean search alongside semantic search
quote: you might create a keyword query like "semaglutide AND diabetes." That query returns every paper in Elicit containing those keywords.

text: Combine multiple search strategies and data sources into one reproducible review protocol
quote: running multiple search strategies in parallel, combining different data sources (like semantic questions, Boolean strings, and Clinical Trial registries) into a single, reproducible protocol

text: Advanced filters restrict search to a specific journal or to highly cited papers
quote: Advanced search filters are a powerful hidden feature in the Find Papers workflow. You can use them to search within a particular journal, restrict your search to highly-cited papers, and more!

text: Research Agent detects and applies filters described in a natural-language query
quote: The simplest way to filter is to just say what you want in your Research Agent query. Elicit will automatically detect and apply the right filter.

text: Public API for searching papers and generating automated research reports from code
quote: The Elicit API lets you access Elicit's research capabilities programmatically: search 138 million+ academic papers and generate automated research reports from your own code, scripts, and workflows.

text: All API functionality is also available through an MCP server for Claude and other MCP clients
quote: All API functionality is also available via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, enabling use from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP-compatible clients.

text: Chat compares and contrasts papers, summarizes them along chosen dimensions, and clusters them by topic
quote: Chat enables you to: Compare and contrast papers - Summarize multiple papers along specific dimensions (like their methodologies) - Cluster papers by a certain topic

text: Unlimited chat with papers using full-text access
quote: Unlimited chat with papers with full-text access

text: Highlights where content came from within the relevant papers
quote: We then highlight the source of the content within the relevant papers.

text: Automated full-text screening step that catches mismatches before data extraction
quote: Full-Text Screening is a distinct, automated step in the Systematic Review workflow that catches these mismatches before you commit to data extraction.

text: Collections organize Library papers, can be shared with colleagues, and can launch reviews or extractions
quote: Collections help you group related research, arrange it the way you want, share it with colleagues, and quickly launch reviews or extractions.

text: Answers multiple-choice questions about papers by selecting one or more options
quote: Elicit can answer multiple choice questions about papers, choosing one or more options from a list of choices.

text: Labels show which papers have full text ready for extraction and which need action
quote: These labels help you understand at a glance which papers have full text ready for extraction and which may need additional action.

text: Enter any research question to generate a research-backed report
quote: Enter any research question in Elicit to generate a research-backed report!

text: Library has no limit on the number of PDFs it can hold
quote: There is no limit on the number of PDFs your library can hold at this time.

text: Edit paper titles, authors, and abstracts in the Library
quote: Adjust the paper's title or author(s), or edit or add an abstract, by clicking on the paper's row in the Library table and clicking the pencil icon to edit

text: Tag uploaded PDFs with new or existing tags
quote: When uploading PDFs, simply click the "Add tags" button to create a tag or add an existing one to your newly uploaded papers.

text: Fuzzy de-duplication catches similar records that strict rule-based reference managers miss
quote: Reference managers with strict rule-based de-duplication wouldn't detect these similarities but Elicit can.

text: Deleted items can be recovered for 30 days before permanent deletion
quote: They will stay there for 30 days before being permanently deleted, and are recoverable at any point in that window.

text: Premium PDF parsing handles complex figures, awkward layouts, and heavy formulae
quote: complex figures, awkward layouts, and heavy formulae, Premium PDF parsing often gets further than standard parsing

text: Routines act on what they find: filtering on custom criteria, updating artifacts, or writing summaries
quote: A Routine can act on what it finds and hand you a finished analysis: it can filter on criteria an Alert couldn't, update an artifact, or write the summary

text: Claims up to 80% time savings on systematic reviews without losing accuracy
quote: Elicit can help you save up to 80% of time usually spent on a systematic review without sacrificing accuracy.

text: Shared items arrive in the Recents view
quote: Recents is also where anything shared with you arrives.
